Messages.Author: Kulaid
Messages.Body:
If jost takes an action, and is unblocked. You can't mask it to another
vampire unless they also have +1 stealth on that action?

And if a vampire hunts, you can't mask it to Zoe to since she can't get
+1 stealth on the hunt? And vice versa? If zoe hunts, you can't mask
it to another vampire because the "Zoe does not get the usual +1 stealth
when hunting" is an effect?
